purpose: y2s74-thumbdiag: DIAGNOSTIC Nord2Metal = y2s73-thumbfix + (1) Photos frames that only CLEAR a full-screen target are probed too ('PHOTOS frame n=... draws=0'), (2) in backboardd, every composite that samples a full-screen IOSurface (an application's drawable) reads 3 texels of it at completion ('PHOTOS COMPOSITE n=...: backboardd samples surface S WxH fmt F: c= tl= bl=', first 64 then 1 in 64). Off with /var/db/nord2-metal/no-photos-probe. Says whether the grid that vanishes is a black drawable presented by Photos or a good drawable composited as black.
